properties.description: Compares paired boundaries across the eight axes an interface spec carries and reports where two designs conflict, where they merely differ in wording, and where NOBODY HAS SAID. Built because a measurement showed the ordinary detectors cannot do it: with a seam hand-drawn between two real designs they produced zero findings, since they reason about structure and a contract mismatch is a comparison of properties across a pair. Always names its own blind spot — the types that cross a boundary are part of the contract and invisible to it.
properties.name: Say when two linked designs disagree at a boundary
